templates.name: Storware Backup and Recovery
templates.description:
Comprehensive monitoring template for Storware vProtect/Backup & Recovery via REST API.

Features:
- API health monitoring
- Node status tracking
- Task monitoring
- Per-instance backup status with automatic discovery
- Backup destination capacity monitoring

Requirements:
- Storware vProtect 7.x with API access (port 8181)
- Configure host macros: {$STORWARE.API.URL}, {$STORWARE.USER}, {$STORWARE.PASSWORD}

Version: 4.0 - Added per-backup instance monitoring
